11	
12	The `GL₂(k)` action on `P¹_k` preserves the structure morphism and all morphism properties used by
13	the divisor-representability construction. Consequently a finite affine map `π : C ⟶ P¹_k` can be

30	    (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) : Y ⟶ P1 k :=
31	  π ≫ P1.autOfMatrix k M
32	
33	instance isAffineHom_twistedP1Map {Y : Scheme.{u}} (π : Y ⟶ P1 k)

35	    IsAffineHom (twistedP1Map π M) := by
36	  letI : IsAffineHom (P1.autOfMatrix k M) :=
37	    MorphismProperty.of_isIso @IsAffineHom (P1.autOfMatrix k M)
38	  change IsAffineHom (π ≫ P1.autOfMatrix k M)
39	  exact IsAffineHom.comp_iff.mpr (by infer_instance)
40

42	    [IsFinite π] (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) :
43	    IsFinite (twistedP1Map π M) := by
44	  letI : IsFinite (P1.autOfMatrix k M) :=
45	    MorphismProperty.of_isIso @IsFinite (P1.autOfMatrix k M)
46	  change IsFinite (π ≫ P1.autOfMatrix k M)
47	  exact IsFinite.comp_iff.mpr (by infer_instance)

51	    IsDominant (twistedP1Map π M) := by

53	    MorphismProperty.of_isIso @IsDominant (P1.autOfMatrix k M)

213	
214	/-- The substitution attached to an invertible matrix satisfies the hypothesis of `Proj.map`:
215	its inverse substitution is a two-sided inverse. -/
216	theorem irrelevant_le_map_substGradedHom (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) :
217	    𝒜₊ ≤ 𝒜₊.map (substGradedHom (mat M)) := by
218	  refine irrelevant_le_map_of_rightInverse _ (substGradedHom (mat M⁻¹)) fun x => ?_
219	  have h : substGradedHom ((mat M⁻¹) * (mat M)) =
220	      (substGradedHom (mat M)).comp (substGradedHom (mat M⁻¹)) := substGradedHom_mul _ _

223

225	`Xᵢ ↦ ∑ⱼ Mᵢⱼ Xⱼ` attached to `M ∈ GL₂(k)` induces, via functoriality of `Proj`, an
226	automorphism of `P¹_k`. -/

228	  Proj.map (substGradedHom (mat M)) (irrelevant_le_map_substGradedHom k M)
229

232	  refine Eq.trans (Proj.map_congr (g := GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) ?_ _ (by simp)) Proj.map_id
233	  rw [Units.val_one, substGradedHom_one]
234	
235	/-- Functoriality. `Proj.map` is contravariant, so `M ↦ autOfMatrix M` is an
236	**anti**-homomorphism for composition of morphisms: `γ_{MN} = γ_N ≫ γ_M`.
237	(Equivalently, it *is* a homomorphism into `Aut (P1 k)`, whose multiplication is
238	`(f * g).hom = g.hom ≫ f.hom`; see `P1.autMonoidHom`.) -/
239	theorem autOfMatrix_mul (M N : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) :
240	    autOfMatrix k (M * N) = autOfMatrix k N ≫ autOfMatrix k M := by
241	  have h := Proj.map_comp (substGradedHom (mat M)) (substGradedHom (mat N))
242	    (irrelevant_le_map_substGradedHom k M) (irrelevant_le_map_substGradedHom k N)
243	  refine Eq.trans (Proj.map_congr ?_ _ _) h
244	  rw [Units.val_mul, substGradedHom_mul]
